scope: B portfolio healthcare and staples; long-only common equities; no ETF, leverage or short; proposed weights are conditional research ceilings and require competition security eligibility
source_posture: Official issuer releases and SEC filings read live. Prices from parent-provided quotes.json. Company guidance is not analyst consensus. No invented target prices.

facts.claim: Q3 sales $25.399bn, +5.9%; GAAP EPS $0.09 versus adjusted $2.59 (-7.5% YoY); FY26 adjusted EPS guidance $11.05–11.15.

CFO remarks: approximately $17bn cash/marketable securities, $45bn debt, $28bn net debt; Q3 FCF over $6bn and FY FCF guidance ~$21bn. Proposed ovarian talc settlement $5.5bn conditional on 95% remaining-claim participation; Firefly/Sail expected adjusted EPS dilution $1.36 in 2027. Enterprise review December 8.

stocks.quality: Operational sales grow but GAAP/adjusted divergence is substantial. Talc is an economic obligation even when excluded from adjusted earnings. Cash generation supports resilience; release YTD FCF ~$15.1bn is an estimate and not a completed CFO-capex tie-out. Recurring business development also dilutes next-year earnings. This is not a bond substitute.

valuation_basis.metric: Price / management FY26 adjusted EPS midpoint $11.10
valuation_basis.interpretation: Material premium to low-single-digit reported adjusted EPS growth; adjusted earnings yield about 4.21%. EPS excludes special items; do not compare directly to GAAP PE or treat FY27 as unchanged. A 10% multiple contraction at unchanged earnings implies 10% price loss, independent of operating defensiveness.

stocks.catalyst: Q3 already reported; Q4 pipeline/approval updates have no confirmed date before November 13. December 8 enterprise review lies outside the competition window. Talc participation and adverse court developments remain unscheduled near-term events.
stocks.downside_mechanism: Strongest bear case: expensive defensive rotation meets unexpected settlement costs, weak MedTech execution and 2027 M&A dilution; adjusted earnings hide cash obligations. Short competition horizon may not monetize decade-end growth.
stocks.falsifier: Analyst rules: suspend adds on any lowered FY26 adjusted EPS below $11.05 or FCF guidance below $21bn; reassess immediately if 95% talc participation fails or proposed $5.5bn liability materially increases. If entry loses 6% on a closing basis, halve/re-underwrite instead of averaging down. Stops do not cap gaps.
stocks.decision: Retain but reduce old 8% target to <=5%; Monday exploratory <=2–3% only after price/eligibility checks. No automatic add to 8% because healthcare outperformed.

risk_budget.interpretation: Design assumption, not VaR or worst loss.

No confirmed company-specific positive catalyst before November 13; competition eligibility not verified.

H1 CFO $7.265bn, capex $0.587bn, cash dividends $6.156bn; calculated CFO-capex $6.678bn. June debt $70.822bn including current maturities, cash $6.569bn. Subsequent Apogee financing can change leverage.

Adjusted EPS strips amortization/contingent consideration while acquired IPR&D is included when incurred and excluded from unforecast future quarters. H1 CFO-capex after cash dividends leaves just ~$0.522bn before buybacks/acquisitions/debt service; high dividend is not free deleveraging. H1 is seasonal and not an annual cash forecast.

valuation_basis.metric: Price / latest management FY26 adjusted EPS midpoint $13.86
valuation_basis.interpretation: Adjusted earnings yield ~4.86%; clean comparison must use October IPR&D-inclusive guide. Parent longbridge normalized Q3 EPS 3.7788 lacks independent revision timestamp and may exclude different items; a print of $3.75 is within company guide, not automatically a miss to a comparable forecast.

stocks.catalyst: October 30 premarket Q3 results inside window. Key tests: Skyrizi/Rinvoq demand, guidance reconciliation, Apogee financing and cash generation. October 22 pipeline news already known; 2027 submission is not a near-term revenue catalyst.
stocks.downside_mechanism: Strongest bear case: concentrated growth drugs face pricing/competition or less-than-priced-in trial differentiation while acquisition leverage and future IPR&D cut distributable cash. Statistical significance does not prove superiority versus other treatments; no cross-trial efficacy claim.
stocks.falsifier: Do not enter pre-earnings. Post-earnings reject if like-for-like FY adjusted EPS guide falls below $13.76 for underlying operating reasons, or two growth drugs fail to support revenue trajectory. Separate accounting/deal IPR&D cuts from demand weakness but both consume capital. Post-event initial <=1.5%; only grow <=3% after an orderly full session and updated cash/debt review. A closing 7% loss from entry triggers halve/re-underwrite.
stocks.decision: Wait: Monday 0%; reduce old 4% target to conditional <=3% after October 30. A strong company and positive trial can still be a poor pre-event position.

risk_budget.interpretation: Design stress, not a maximum. Holding zero before event avoids this specific pre-event exposure.

facts.claim: FY27 Q1 sales $23.276bn, organic +4%, volume +2.4%; core EPS $2.00 (+1%), GAAP $1.97. Core operating margin -80bp. FY27 core EPS guide $6.89–7.11 unchanged; organic growth 1–3%. CFO $5.767bn less capex $1.366bn gives calculated FCF $4.401bn. Cash $15.365bn, debt due within one year $17.028bn and long-term debt $21.897bn.

FY26 sales $87.032bn, operating income $19.748bn (-3%); June ratings Aa3/AA- stable. Existing $8bn backup facilities were undrawn, with the 364-day portion scheduled to expire October 2026 at the filing date.

stocks.quality: Broad household-product demand and improving volume support the business. CFO exceeds net income, but part of cash conversion comes from payables timing; quarterly FCF is not an annualized forecast. EPS growth lagging sales and compressed margins show raw material/energy/transport pressure. Core removes incremental restructuring that still consumes value/cash. September cash build includes added short-term borrowing and precedes October 1 Thorne acquisition, so cash alone overstates financial improvement.

valuation_basis.metric: Price / FY27 management core EPS midpoint $7.00
valuation_basis.interpretation: Core earnings yield ~4.34%, for guidance of 0–3% EPS growth. Cash-flow quality is preferable to a simple sales story, yet low growth and rates make a high defensive multiple vulnerable. FY27 core EPS is not GAAP or calendar-2027 EPS.

stocks.catalyst: October 22 earnings already reported. No newly confirmed company-specific binary positive catalyst before November 13 in reviewed sources; main path is post-earnings price discovery, macro rates/input costs and defensive rotation.
stocks.downside_mechanism: Strongest bear case: investors pay a defensive premium while commodity/transport cost inflation and price-sensitive consumers prevent margin recovery. A rotation back to growth or rising bond yields can compress the multiple even with stable revenue.
stocks.falsifier: Analyst rules: freeze adds/re-underwrite if FY27 core EPS low end falls below $6.89, organic growth guide low end below 1%, or cash productivity guide below 85%. During this short window no fresh quarterly volume proof may arrive; use closing-price drawdown >=6% from entry to halve/re-underwrite, and never average down merely because products are necessities.
stocks.decision: Retain as portfolio stabilizer <=7%, but Monday <=3–4% and require post-results stabilization; do not treat 10-day staples momentum as an entry signal on its own.

valuation_basis.interpretation: Adjusted earnings yield ~2.37%; material duration/multiple risk despite defensive grocery exposure. With EPS held fixed, a multiple decline from 42.28x to 36x implies about -14.9%; to 32x about -24.3%. These are explicit sensitivity assumptions, not fair values or target prices.

stocks.downside_mechanism: Strongest bear case: expensive low-margin retailer must reinvest tariff windfalls while wage/healthcare/claims and fulfillment costs grow. Stable spending can coexist with sharply lower share prices when the multiple contracts; PG plus WMT are not independent inflation hedges.
stocks.falsifier: Analyst rules: suspend if like-for-like FY EPS low end falls below $2.80, or new official evidence shows US transaction growth turning negative. Do not rely on November 19 results to repair the trade before November 13. Initial closing drawdown >=6% or ongoing underperformance versus consumer-staples proxy for three sessions calls for exit/re-underwrite; price thresholds are policy choices, not historical probabilities.
stocks.decision: Demote: old 5% target becomes <=3% optional diversifier; Monday 0–2% only after stabilization. If cash is needed for better event-backed ideas, omit WMT first rather than force broad-sector coverage.

portfolio_readthrough.factor_overlap: Defensive label does not diversify valuation duration, inflation input costs, US drug pricing or crowded low-beta positioning. Retain cash instead of moving unused ABBV event budget automatically into PG/WMT. All weights are total NAV, including cash. No assurance of investment gain or competition standing.
